scenario: `scope explicit` (default) facts must be manually retracted per LSCO.2.1 — they do not participate in logical truth maintenance. Retract the trigger: the explicit-scoped emitted fact stays in working memory.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Result:
    entity_id: String

rule make_result:
    Trig t
->
    emit Result entity_id: t.entity_id
